fragments.source: The separate `register-sentinel-themes.json` candidate appends nine Ukraine Atlas, 1994 Forever and Spend Network pictures to the unchanged baseline. Validate it with `--previous authoring/production/register.json --files`; use the source view’s explicit snapshot links to compare 27 and 36 produced picture works. Its finite `sentinel-world` adapter verifies the original, descriptor, provenance and exact mission/theme owner without executing the chapter compiler. Three reused layouts remain three layouts. The snapshot selector is read-only and cannot publish a chapter or approve an asset. Example: “Inspect the Sentinel theme candidate, preview one exact original, list its outstanding checks and prepare a separate runtime adoption; preserve the baseline and all saved/earned owner identities.”
